baseline_binding.role: Validate/bind the exact registered WBG v1.0.0 base and its CGS v16.3.3 prerequisite.

hierarchical_sequence: Validate/source-bind CoSyn CGS v16.3.3 as required by the baseline WBG bind template.
Validate the registered WBG v1.0.0 11-member content fingerprint.
Treat externally ratified baseline status as effective under the Root's grandfathering exception.
Load WBG Artifact Registration and Sync Contract v1.0.1.
Discover available WBG extensions from the Extension Index and/or directly supplied conforming artifacts.
Validate each extension's versioned URN, family ID, integrity, dependencies, conflicts, status, and activation.
Register eligible RATIFIED extensions as ACTIVE or DORMANT.
If this is initial WBG setup and Project Governance Q&A is not already complete, preserve the baseline requirement that the next turn begins Project Governance Q&A.
runtime_boundary: This profile cannot load unavailable files by itself. Source availability remains a host/context function.
